cuda.command: cargo test --release -p solver --features gpu --target-dir target/action-sizing --test gpu --test preflop_gpu -- --test-threads=1
cuda.initial_new_fixture_divergence: Initial new routing fixture used the generic 300-iteration pure-decision comparison. The squeeze case had 371 clashes among 85,790 decisive entries, exceeding that helper's 0.2% allowance. All 17 pre-existing CUDA tests passed, and early full-regret parity passed. The new fixture was then made specific to routing: full regret and strategy-sum arrays at each of the first five iterations (<1e-3), exact forced policy matrices, and 300-iteration CPU/GPU and independent device EV/gap comparisons (<0.02 bb). No existing test or tolerance was loosened. Late pure-decision agreement is not asserted for the new fixture; small long-run EV/gap deltas are consistent with floating-point trajectory divergence, not a proof of its cause.

server.initial_environment_error: Initial command omitted nvrtc DLL directory from PATH; GPU report test could not load nvrtc. Corrected environment rerun passed, with no source change.

sizing.label: History-backed sizes
sizing.summary: Size weights and units match the supplied historical size distribution before legal-menu projection.
details: Values are absolute raise-to amounts in big blinds, including the player's existing investment and excluding antes.
Ordinary size weights map to the nearest legal non-jam option in log space; ties go smaller. Sizes are independent of the hand, conditional on an ordinary raise. Weights are not sample counts.
Jams use the separate action probability. If no ordinary raise is legal, the existing fallback routing applies.
Matching checks the supplied distribution, not source authenticity or calibration. Sparse situations can borrow pooled size estimates.

Sizing (raise-to bb): iso paid 1: 1833 non-jam raises from 398 sessions, pooled. Counts describe source pools, not certainty at this seat. Conditional on ordinary raising; hands and stacks pooled; nearest legal non-jam menu projection. Unsupported positions use a pool, not invented positional observations. Retrospective evidence only.

Non-jam sizes learned from Ignition NL10 regular: iso raise-to bb by free/paid and limper count; re-raise multiples of the previous faced total. Distributions are conditional on raising and pool hands/stacks. Sparse iso groups borrow same-limper-count/all-iso evidence; sparse later groups keep legacy rules. Historical retrospective validation, not new source-format support. Opening/hand/jam probabilities unchanged.

installation.note: Saved both sessions before migration. Five current Ignition seats explicitly upgraded only in sizing/source metadata, then re-solved and saved. Postflop roots/config/locks unchanged. Final server uses canonical library; older servers were not stopped.

limitations: Retrospective reused development periods; no new independent holdout or win-rate claim.
Sizes are independent of hand conditional on raising. Stacks and earlier histories remain pooled.
Late pure-decision parity is not asserted for the new GPU fixture; strict early arenas and300-iteration EV/gap comparisons pass, and all17 preexisting GPU tests pass.
The existing conditional calling probabilities and postflop valuation assumptions are unchanged.
Old saved games retain stored policies until explicitly updated; old binaries ignore multiplier metadata and retain fallback.
